title: Marketplace Orders Replacement-Charge Refund Amount
content:
**Amount.** On Marketplace Orders, the replacement-charge refund is the whole replacement charge captured on the order, rounded half up to the cent.

## Input

The replacement charge captured on the order is the total of the payment captures on the order recorded as unreturned-replacement charges. Order-total captures (the buyer's original payment for the order) are not part of it.

## Worked examples (hypothetical inputs)

| Captures on the order (example) | Replacement charge captured | Refund |
|---|---|---|
| order-total capture 97.20; unreturned-replacement charge 48.60 | 48.60 | 48.60 |
| order-total capture 97.20; unreturned-replacement charge 52.10 | 52.10 | 52.10 |

The order-total capture plays no part in the figure.
